request: Design sofa and rug as one warm, chic, curated palette. Previous kilim is not fixed.
palette: Smoky plum-brown sofa; old-gold/straw and olive Arts-and-Crafts-inspired rug; flax cushion, olive lumbar, camel throw; existing oak/brass/personal collection.

Input image2 is SUPPORTING actual owned-shelf reference, not a second panel. Keep exact camera/crop, unchanged kitchen/dining and background geometry. Single landscape photo showing the NEW SOFA AND NEW RUG TOGETHER.

SOFA: a tailored straight three-seater approximately same220-225cm footprint as input, modest gently curved LOW arms and short dark timber feet, proper comfortable proportions. Soft matte SHORT-PILE COTTON-VELVET character, rich nap and gentle depth with little shine; refined traditional upholstery, NOT glossy polyester, leather, deep chesterfield buttons, giant rolled arms or modular blocks. Keep it same wall/position facing TV, no chaise.
RUG: replace the brick/slate diamond kilim COMPLETELY with a DIFFERENT coordinated traditional Arts-and-Crafts-inspired WOOL rug. A soft ANTIQUE OLD-GOLD / WARM STRAW ground, softened flax highlights, muted OLIVE and TOBACCO stylised leaf/tulip/branch motifs. The foliage is spaced and flowing at medium scale, open enough to see quiet ground, with a broad SIMPLER olive/tobacco framing border. English garden/tapestry character, NOT another small repetitive Persian floral medallion, diamond kilim, modern abstract, plain sisal, blue-red tribal rug or bright mustard-yellow carpet. Gold means softly aged straw/ochre wool, NOT metallic shine or vivid yellow. Pattern muted, refined and matte, gently timeworn without fake blur. It should complement warm plum sofa and earth/wood objects and feel like a different rug family from previous iterations.
Rug size roughly same substantial seating rectangle as input, sofa front feet on it, visible oak margin before black steel doors, stopped before kitchen, open TV-side walking route. Do not enlarge room/rug or place rug under whole wall area.
TEXTILES: remove the previous rust/olive/flax-three-cushion grouping for this palette trial. Exactly TWO accent cushions: one generous plain warm FLAX textured linen square with subtle plum piping, one smaller muted OLIVE lumbar with a very fine old-gold woven stripe. One thin CAMEL wool throw folded neatly over reception-end sofa arm. Let upholstery show, no stack of cushions/blankets.
EXISTING COLLECTION IS CENTRAL, NOT GENERIC PROPS: retain black leaning timber ladder shelf with exact 5 levels and user's actual objects as source reference: top dark seated figure and2dark holders; next copper-coloured pot pair, tiny tower-like lidded ornament and brown scene plate; middle red glass piece, dark patterned sphere and silver-toned figurine; next pale bird, cream camel-like animal and upright carved figure; bottom existing books. Do not replace/recolour them with new matching pottery or add new plants on shelf. Keep deep red Vietnamese hat ABOVE shelf once only. Retain original round clock above sofa, not generic landscape.
Lighting remains real room daylight and one small warm lamp, wall paint unchanged. Photorealistic texture: patinated oak, matte plum velvet, wool rug, linen and brass. Quiet, warm, collected and elegant, not staged luxury glitter. No extra ornaments, flowers, sideboards, benches, people, text, watermark or collage.
